mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.project_id, d.result, d.reason, d.triggered_by, d.created_at, a.name AS triggered_by_name FROM dev_run d LEFT JOIN account a ON a.id = d.triggered_by WHERE d.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dev_run (project_id, result, reason, triggered_by) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{result}, #{reason}, #{triggeredBy})
